_note: Deterministic safety numbers used as code-level backstops after generation (components/coach/bakken-plan-panel.tsx) — not prompt text the AI can ignore. Edit these directly (here, or via the local brain editor at /dev/brain-editor) to change the hard limits without touching code.

easyDayMinutesCap._note: Max minutes for a plain easy/recovery day with no fixed rep structure. A day over this gets its duration clamped and distance recomputed at the same pace.

cutbackWeek._note: Every Nth week within a base/build/peak stage gets its flexible-volume target cut by cutbackVolumeMultiplier.
